highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Ubiquiti patches 3 critical remote code execution vulnerabilities and Critical Avada WordPress theme flaw enables zero-click RCE. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: FBI seizes hacking tools it says China used to attack NASA, DOE, US Senate and other critical networks. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
